privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
Effective Date: March 10, 2026

STN-Labz, maintains a very strict protocol regarding data privacy and the protection of digital content and records. This policy outlines the collection, storage, and restricted access of digital footprints within my domain

Information We Collect
We believe in minimal data collection.

We only collect information that you voluntarily provide to us:

  • Contact Information:
    When you use our "Connect" or "Contact" forms, we will collect your name, email address, and the content of your message.
  • Account Data:
    If you create an account on any of our systems, we will store your username and encrypted credentials.
  • Media Interaction: If you interact with our media or content modules, we may collect data related to your engagement with that content.

How we Use Your Information
We use the data collect strictly for:

  • Responding to your inquiries.
  • Providing access to our website's features, data, and content.
  • Maintaining the security and integrity of our domains.

Data Storage & Security
Your data is stored within this website's proprietary infrastructure.

  • We use industry-standard encryption for sensitive data.
  • We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

Cookies and Tracking
Our systems may use essential cookies to maintain your session and keep you logged in. We do not use invasive third-party tracking pixels or aggressive advertising cookies.

Third-Party Services
While we keep most things in-house, we utilize a third part email class to facilitate secure email transmissions. These services are used only to ensure your messages reach us and our messages, reach our patrons, safely.

Your Rights
You have the right to request a copy of the data that we hold about you or to request that we delete your information from our database. To do so, please contact us. You may also remove your account from your profile page.

Changes to This Policy
We reserve the right to update this policy as my modules and systems evolve. Any changes will be posted directly on this page.
